//***********************************************************************************************************
// Here are two articles to help you get started with KQL:
// KQL reference guide - https://aka.ms/KQLguide
// SQL - KQL conversions - https://aka.ms/sqlcheatsheet
//***********************************************************************************************************

// Use "take" to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
Bike_Table
| take 100

// See how many records are in the table.
Bike_Table
| count

// This query returns the number of ingestions per hour in the given table.
Bike_Table
| summarize IngestionCount = count() by bin(ingestion_time(), 1h)

Bike_Table
| where Neighbourhood  == 'Chelsea'
| project current_time, No_Bikes
| render timechart 

Explain
Select top 10 * from Bike_Table

Bike_Table
| project BikepointID, Street, Neighbourhood, Latitude, Longitude, No_Bikes, No_Empty_Docks, current_time

Bike_Table
| summarize arg_max(current_time,No_Bikes) by BikepointID
| sort by BikepointID
| render  columnchart with (ycolumns=No_Bikes, xcolumn=BikepointID)

Bike_Table
| where Neighbourhood  == 'Chelsea'

Bike_Table
| summarize arg_max(current_time,No_Bikes, Neighbourhood, No_Empty_Docks,lat= todouble(Latitude), lon= todouble(Longitude)) by BikepointID
